description: This file contains functions to map and transform task-related data structures such as task views, task details, flow views, and flow details, primarily for use in a task management or workflow system.

methods.name: mapTaskRunAggregateSummary
methods.description: Maps a TaskRegistrySummary object to a TaskRunAggregateSummary object, copying relevant summary fields.

methods.name: mapTaskRunView
methods.description: Transforms a TaskRecord into a TaskRunView object, including optional fields based on presence.

methods.name: mapTaskRunDetail
methods.description: Returns a TaskRunView by mapping a TaskRecord, identical to mapTaskRunView.

methods.name: mapTaskFlowView
methods.description: Transforms a TaskFlowRecord into a TaskFlowView object, including optional fields.

methods.name: mapTaskFlowDetail
methods.description: Creates a detailed view of a task flow, combining flow data, associated tasks, and an optional summary.
